 Soccer-Arsenal claim top spot as Havertz seals win at Liverpool
 Monday, 02 Nov 2026
 | 2:53 AM MYT
 share 
 bookmark 
 Soccer Football - Premier League - Liverpool v Arsenal - Anfield, Liverpool, Britain - November 1, 2026 Arsenal's Kai Havertz celebrates scoring their first goal REUTERS/Phil Noble 
 LIVERPOOL, England, Nov ⁠1 (Reuters) - Champions Arsenal moved three points ⁠clear at the top of the ‌Premier League with Kai Havertz's early goal securing a statement 1-0 victory over Liverpool at Anfield on ​Sunday.
 German striker Havertz tapped in ⁠from Declan Rice's low ⁠cross in the 16th minute after the ⁠hosts ‌were caught out trying to play the ball out of defence.
 Liverpool ⁠responded strongly as halftime approached with Florian ​Wirtz curling ‌a free kick against the crossbar ⁠and Alexis ​Mac Allister heading a good chance over the bar.
 Arsenal weathered the storm though and ⁠defended superbly to keep Liverpool largely ​at arm's length after the break and seal their first Premier League win at Anfield ⁠for 14 years.
 Mikel Arteta's side replace Manchester City at the top with 24 points from nine games, with City on ​21 after losing at home ⁠to Brighton and Hove Albion on Saturday.
 Liverpool's ​second league defeat of ‌the season left them nine ​points behind Arsenal in fifth place.
 (Reporting by Martyn HermanEditing by Toby Davis)
